summary.headline: Astrological Manuscripts 14–17
summary.text: Catalog entries 14–17 describe Florentine manuscripts with astrological excerpts on finding a birth sign from a name, stellar significations, treasure location in the fifteenth house, comets, the ecliptic, and predictions from zodiac signs for men and women. The entries also note Cornutus’s work on the gods, a medical codex owned by Manuel Marmaras, and manuscript references to Bandini and Wachsmuth.
